study_id: HVAC-EVI post-BSERT prospective-internal matched-hour sensitivity R1
status: frozen before this analysis model fitting or outcome inspection; not externally preregistered
baseline: V36R2 frozen and unaffected; source V25 exact raw Wang and V21 matrices
dataset: within-building Wang Figshare v3, 3 buildings, 41 held-out AHUs, labels Normal/RATSF/SFF only
time_handling: exact source timestamps parsed without time-zone conversion; duplicate AHU/timestamp rows dropped entirely from both train eligibility and held-out evaluation in ALL buildings

arms.k1: 128 known-class records per class from one eligible source AHU (384 rows total)
arms.k2: 64 same anchor-A records per class plus 64 matched-time class records from a different donor AHU B (384 rows total)
arms.paired_exchange: choose exactly 64 distinct A-B same-time-key matched pairs per class, select 64 additional distinct anchor-A records; k1 takes matched A + extra A, k2 takes matched B + extra A; key histogram per class exactly equal across arms
arms.source_eligibility: A and B each have at least 128 nonduplicated source class records and at least 64 one-to-one shared time-key pairings; all selected AHUs differ from held-out target
arms.donor_choice: uniform over all feasible ordered A,B pairs separately by class, seeded by SHA-256; no target predictor/label/outcome used in selection

matching_designs.status: strict overlapping timestamps, infeasibility retained per held-out AHU
coarser same-month/hour sensitivity across all feasible AHUs; does not control day

metric: mean of per-target-AHU and per-label recall over represented classes and feasible held-out target AHUs; 10 paired acquisition repeats; report exact class-specific support, no filling missing targets
comparison: k2 minus k1 in percentage points for each model and building within the same matching design; never pool buildings or treat repetitions as independent AHUs
no_postoutcome_changes: no tuning eligibility, matching time key, models, thresholds, repetitions, target pool or objective based on outcomes
